name: Ahmedabad
description: Gujarat's largest city — heritage pols, Sabarmati riverfront and the best street food in western India.

name: Mumbai
description: India's financial capital. Art-deco seafront, Gateway of India and a restaurant scene that never closes.

name: New Delhi
description: Mughal tombs, colonial avenues and Old Delhi's lanes, all within an hour of each other.

name: Jaipur
description: The Pink City — Amber Fort, Hawa Mahal and Rajasthan's most walkable old town.

name: Udaipur
description: Lake palaces, rooftop dinners over Pichola and the Aravalli hills behind.

name: Jodhpur
description: The Blue City under Mehrangarh Fort, on the edge of the Thar.

name: Jaisalmer
description: A living sandstone fort and desert camps in the dunes at Sam.

name: Pushkar
description: A temple town round a sacred lake, best in camel-fair season.

name: Agra
description: The Taj Mahal at sunrise, plus Agra Fort and the quieter Itmad-ud-Daulah.

name: Varanasi
description: Ghats, evening aarti and the oldest continuously inhabited city in India.

name: Rishikesh
description: Yoga ashrams on one bank, white-water rafting on the other.

name: Bir
description: India's paragliding capital, with a Tibetan monastery colony and slow cafés.

name: Manali
description: Base camp for Solang, Rohtang and the Parvati valley beyond.

name: Kasol
description: Riverside village in Parvati valley — the trailhead for Kheerganga.

name: Shimla
description: The Raj-era summer capital, reached by the Kalka toy train.

name: Leh
description: High-desert monasteries, Pangong Tso and the road over Khardung La.

name: Srinagar
description: Houseboats on Dal Lake, Mughal gardens and the Gulmarg gondola an hour away.

name: Amritsar
description: The Golden Temple, its langar, and the Wagah border ceremony at dusk.

name: Darjeeling
description: Tea gardens, the Himalayan Railway and Kanchenjunga at first light from Tiger Hill.

name: Kolkata
description: Colonial bones, coffee-house arguments and the best Bengali cooking anywhere.

name: Shillong
description: Waterfalls, living root bridges at Cherrapunji and Meghalaya's music scene.

name: Panaji
description: Goa's Latin quarter, with the north beaches and Old Goa churches both close.

name: Gokarna
description: Temple town with a string of walk-in beaches south of it.

name: Hampi
description: A Vijayanagara ruin field scattered across boulders on the Tungabhadra.

name: Coorg
description: Coffee estates, Abbey Falls and homestays in the Western Ghats.

name: Bengaluru
description: Breweries, bookshops and the jumping-off point for most of south India.

name: Chennai
description: Marina beach, Carnatic concert season and filter coffee done properly.

name: Puducherry
description: A French quarter on the Coromandel coast, with Auroville up the road.

name: Ooty
description: Nilgiri hill station reached by a rack railway, with tea slopes all around.

name: Kochi
description: Fort Kochi's Chinese nets, Jew Town spice godowns and Kathakali at dusk.

name: Alappuzha
description: Backwater houseboats through the Kuttanad paddy country.

name: Munnar
description: Tea estates on ridge after ridge, with Eravikulam's tahr above them.

name: Hyderabad
description: Charminar, Golconda and the biryani that argument is about.

name: Kathmandu
description: Durbar squares, Boudhanath and the permit office for every Nepal trek.

name: Pokhara
description: Phewa Lake under the Annapurnas — paragliding, and the Poon Hill trailhead.

name: Colombo
description: Galle Face green, Pettah markets and Sri Lanka's rail network radiating out.

name: Kandy
description: The Temple of the Tooth, a lake to walk round, and the hill-country train.

name: Thimphu
description: Bhutan's capital — dzongs, the Buddha Dordenma and no traffic lights.

name: Bangkok
description: Temples, night markets and the best transit-to-street-food ratio in Asia.

name: Chiang Mai
description: Walled old city, Doi Suthep above it, and northern Thai food.

name: Phuket
description: Andaman beaches and the boat launch for Phi Phi and Phang Nga.

name: Hanoi
description: Old-quarter alleys, Hoan Kiem at dawn, and the road out to Ha Long.

name: Ho Chi Minh City
description: War Remnants Museum, Ben Thanh, and the Mekong Delta day trips.

name: Denpasar
description: Bali's gateway — Ubud's terraces, Uluwatu's cliffs and the surf at Canggu.

name: Singapore
description: Hawker centres, Gardens by the Bay and the easiest first stop in Asia.

name: Kuala Lumpur
description: Petronas Towers, Batu Caves and a food scene of three cuisines at once.

name: Tokyo
description: Thirteen distinct cities pretending to be one. Start in Yanaka, end in Shibuya.

name: Kyoto
description: Sixteen hundred temples, Fushimi Inari before six, and Nishiki market after.

name: Osaka
description: Dotonbori's neon, Osaka Castle and the least formal food in Japan.

name: Dubai
description: Burj Khalifa, desert dunes an hour out, and the old creek souks.

name: Abu Dhabi
description: Sheikh Zayed Mosque, Louvre Abu Dhabi and the Liwa dunes beyond.

name: Istanbul
description: Two continents, Hagia Sophia and Sultanahmet, and ferries as public transport.

name: London
description: Free national museums, markets on Sundays and the whole country by rail.

name: Edinburgh
description: A castle on a crag, closes off the Royal Mile, and Arthur's Seat to climb.

name: Paris
description: Museums that need three days each, and a bakery on every second corner.

name: Nice
description: The Promenade des Anglais, Vieux Nice, and the Riviera by train.

name: Rome
description: Two thousand years stacked on one hill, and dinner at ten.

name: Venice
description: No cars. Get lost on purpose in Cannaregio and take the vaporetto home.

name: Florence
description: The Uffizi, the Duomo climb, and Tuscany starting at the city limits.

name: Barcelona
description: Gaudí, the Gothic quarter and a beach inside the city.

name: Madrid
description: The Prado, Retiro, and tapas that start when other cities are closing.

name: Zurich
description: Lake swimming in summer, and the cleanest transfer point in the Alps.

name: Interlaken
description: Between two lakes under the Jungfrau — paragliding, and the train to the top.

name: Amsterdam
description: Canal rings, the Rijksmuseum and a bicycle instead of a metro card.

name: Berlin
description: Museum Island, the Wall's remains and a night that runs into Sunday.

name: Munich
description: Beer gardens, the Deutsches Museum and the Alps ninety minutes south.

name: Athens
description: The Acropolis, the new museum below it, and ferries to everywhere.

name: Thira
description: Santorini's caldera rim — Oia at sunset and black-sand beaches below.

name: Lisbon
description: Seven hills, tram 28, and Sintra's palaces forty minutes out.

name: New York
description: Walk one avenue end to end and you have seen four countries.

name: San Francisco
description: Fog, hills, the bridge — and wine country ninety minutes north.

name: Sydney
description: Harbour ferries, the coastal walk to Coogee and the Blue Mountains inland.

name: Melbourne
description: Laneway coffee, street art and the Great Ocean Road as a weekend.

name: Queenstown
description: Adventure-sport capital on Lake Wakatipu, with Milford Sound a day away.
